_about: Every dedicated.toml setting the Server tab edits. Source: https://projectreclaimer.dev/host 'The configuration file', 'Campaign co-op', 'Workshop downloads', 'VPN blocking' (0.9.18). Types follow src/renderer/lib/settings-form.js.

fields.label: Host name
fields.help: Shown under each server's name in the browser, on its card and in its lobby.

fields.label: Admins
fields.help: Player IDs who may kick and ban on every server. IDs appear in the server log when players join.

fields.label: Public address
fields.help: IPv4 address or DNS name players connect to. Leave empty to detect it.

fields.label: UPnP
fields.help: Ask the router to forward the ports. Leave it off on a VPS.

fields.label: Auto update
fields.help: Install new stable releases and restart the servers, interrupting their games.

fields.label: Apply edits while running
fields.help: From 0.9.18 (auto_reload). Saved edits to this file, its playlists and variants, and content/Maps and content/Game Modes apply a couple of seconds later, once they pass the same checks as dedicated check; players stay connected. Off waits for dedicated reload or RCON reload.

fields.label: Stats server
fields.help: Where finished games are reported for player ranks. Empty uses the public service; "off" reports nowhere.

fields.label: Game folder
fields.help: Folder with the Halo 3 game files.

fields.label: Content folder
fields.help: Maps, Game Modes and Mods every server shares.

fields.label: Data folder
fields.help: One folder per server: log, status and settings.

fields.label: Ban list
fields.help: The ban list every server shares.

fields.label: Run local master
fields.help: Run this machine's master. Servers report to the two public masters either way.

fields.label: Master port
fields.help: TCP port.

fields.label: Peers
fields.help: More masters to report to and share listings with.

fields.label: Origin
fields.help: Public address when an HTTPS reverse proxy sits in front of the master.

fields.label: RCON password
fields.help: 8 to 128 characters. Setting one turns on the remote console.

fields.label: RCON address
fields.help: 127.0.0.1 keeps RCON inside the machine/container; the Pterodactyl panel console still works.

fields.label: Workshop item IDs
fields.help: Items the server downloads itself (up to 64 in all). Needs Steam or SteamCMD on the server, which the Pterodactyl container doesn't have: copy mods into content/Mods instead.

fields.label: SteamCMD program
fields.help: Without it, the Steam app on the server PC downloads.

fields.label: SteamCMD account
fields.help: An account that owns MCC.

fields.label: Update check (minutes)
fields.help: Minutes between looks for newer versions of downloaded items; 0 never looks.

fields.label: Block lists
fields.help: Networks VPN blocking refuses. Your own lists replace the defaults; include "default" to add to them.

serverFields.label: Name
serverFields.help: Required and unique, up to 48 characters.

serverFields.label: Port
serverFields.help: Required, unique UDP game port. On Pterodactyl, use the allocation's port.

serverFields.label: Enabled
serverFields.help: Off keeps the entry without running it.

serverFields.label: Max players
serverFields.help: 1 to 127, split-screen players included. A campaign or Halo 3: ODST server takes at most 16.

serverFields.label: Min players
serverFields.help: Wait in the lobby until this many players are in: no playlist vote or automatic start before that. Up to max players.

serverFields.label: Voice chat
serverFields.help: Off turns every kind of voice chat off.

serverFields.label: Global voice (V)
serverFields.help: Each voice scope can be turned off on its own; a talk key whose scope is off stays silent. Off with team voice off leaves only proximity chat.

serverFields.label: Welcome message
serverFields.help: Chat lines every player reads as they join, one per line (up to 5, 300 characters each). {name} is the player's name, {server} the server's. Needs text chat.

serverFields.label: Chat log
serverFields.help: Keep text chat in a file per day.

serverFields.label: Friendly fire
serverFields.help: Off stops players hurting teammates and campaign co-op partners in every game. On follows each game type's own rules.

serverFields.label: Camera
serverFields.help: From 0.9.20. How players see their own character on foot in multiplayer games. First person also covers characters made for third person and game types whose traits set third person; modes built around third person, such as UNSC vs Covenant, and vehicles keep their own views. Campaign and ODST servers aren't affected.

serverFields.label: Block VPNs
serverFields.help: Refuse players who connect through a VPN, proxy or hosting provider.

serverFields.label: Max ping
serverFields.help: Checked as players join. 0 takes everyone.

serverFields.label: Load timeout
serverFields.help: Seconds one player may hold up the next game while loading. 0 waits forever.

serverFields.label: Trust player games (co-op)
serverFields.help: Campaign servers, and ODST's from 0.9.19: when every player's game goes out of step with the server's, take one player's game instead of making everyone load the server's.

serverFields.label: Hidden
serverFields.help: Online but never listed; players join by address.

serverFields.label: Join password
serverFields.help: Empty lets anyone in.

serverFields.label: Share mods
serverFields.help: Players who lack a mod can download it from the server.

serverFields.label: Share rate
serverFields.help: Upload limit for mod downloads. 0 is no limit.

serverFields.label: Character mods
serverFields.help: From 0.9.18. Character mods whose characters the server's multiplayer games add, by the names Customize shows ("Armor Pack" also names Armor Pack v2) or their folders in content/Mods. Needs all 27 multiplayer maps in game/.

serverFields.label: Players must accept them
serverFields.help: From 0.9.18 (require_customization). On: players must take the character mods to join.

serverFields.label: No Halo 3 characters
serverFields.help: From 0.9.18 (no_vanilla_characters). On: every player plays one of the character mods' characters, never Halo 3's own.

serverFields.label: Extra admins
serverFields.help: Admins for this server only.

serverFields.label: RCON port
serverFields.help: Defaults to the game port. The panel console only reaches a server without its own RCON port or password.

campaign._about: campaign = { … } in a [[server]] block (0.9.11+): campaign co-op instead of a playlist, map + game or variant.

fields.label: Mission
fields.help: Where the server starts. It goes on to the next mission it has, and after the last starts again here.

fields.label: Start from
fields.help: 0 is the mission's start; 1 and up its rally points, in the order the Campaign page's Start from lists them.

fields.label: Your Spartans & Elites
fields.help: On: everyone plays as their own Spartan or Elite. Off: the Master Chief and the Arbiter.

fields.label: Character mods
fields.help: From 0.9.18. Character mods co-op players play as (naming any turns Your Spartans & Elites on). Players always take a campaign server's character mods.

odst._about: odst = { … } in a [[server]] block (0.9.19+): Halo 3: ODST campaign or Firefight in co-op. Lists from `dedicated content odst` (0.9.20); unknown keys in it are ignored by the server.
odst.help: The server needs ODST's files: run dedicated init --from --maps odst (about 3.5 GB) on a PC with ODST installed and upload game/. Players need ODST installed in MCC. The console can't change an ODST server's game, so the egg's next-game vote doesn't work on one.
